# Eat This Guide

> Eat This names the plain food that does what you asked for — a nutrient, a feeling or the time of day — with the number for one serving, a cheap pick, and when it is a question for your doctor instead.

## Get Eat This

- [All apps](https://eatthis-docs.aoneahsan.com/apps): every released surface of Eat This.
- [Eat This web app](https://eatthis.aoneahsan.com): runs in any browser on a phone or computer.
